title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF achieved 100% Perinatal Death Audit (PDA) coverage in Uzbekistan&39;s 230 centres, benefiting 928,578 newborns. By addressing neonatal care gaps through training, innovation, and partnerships, UNICEF transformed perinatal care, reduced preventable deaths, and advanced children’s rights to quality healthcare nationwide.;
